children: Arrow Electronics announced that Eric Nowak will retire at the end of March 2027, with Rodney Clark named as his successor and expected to begin employment on November 9, 2026.
Will step down from role effective December 31, 2026; retirement effective end of March 2027
Employment expected to begin November 9, 2026; duties transitioned Dec 31, 2026
Personal reasons; not due to any disagreement with the Company
Succession by Rodney Clark; will remain as employee in advisory capacity until retirement
Has global leadership experience across commercial, channel, and technology sectors; led partner ecosystems, revenue organizations, and transformations at Cisco, Johnson Controls, Microsoft, and IBM

title: Eric Nowak to Retire from Arrow; Rodney Clark to Succeed as President, Global Enterprise Computing Solutions
